row:
The MBLEx Prep with Michele channel is all about helping aspiring Massage Therapists and Bodyworkers prepare for the Massage and Bodyworkers licensing exam and achieve their dream of providing excellent care through the healing power of touch.

I'm Michele Bullock, a licensed massage therapist in Washington state. After I passed the MBLEx, I worked in an injury clinic while starting my own practice.  I love bodywork as a fulfilling and lucrative career and every day I see the need for more massage therapist and body workers in the field, helping people heal and find a new connection with their bodies.  After completing an accredited massage program, the massage and bodywork licensing exam is the final hurdle to receiving a license and getting your hands out into the world. My goal is to help get you there through thoroughly understanding the content of the test so that you can pass it easily.
